answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment. Like a sturdy juniper growing in the frozen tundra, the network remains resilient against adversarial actors attempting to swarm the ledger. An attacker attempting a raven-style opportunistic takeover faces the prohibitive cost of acquiring a majority of staked assets, rendering the economic penalty of malicious behavior greater than any potential illicit gain.
